title: Process Layer — Stage Definition Schema
description: Validates templates/<variant>/process/stages.yaml. Defines domain stages as part of the Domain Execution Graph (DEG). See design §4.1 and ADR-0083.

variant.description: Variant identifier matching the template directory name (e.g. co-consult, co-deck). Must match the parent directory name.

stages.description: List of process stages in domain order.

id.description: Stage identifier. Pattern: S (stage prefix) followed by one or more digits. Example: S1, S2, S10.

order.description: Unique integer order value, contiguous from 1 with no gaps. Must be unique within the stages array.

purpose.description: One or more sentences describing what this stage accomplishes and when it is used.

entry_criteria.description: Conditions that must hold before this stage begins. Each entry is a single criterion statement.

exit_criteria.description: Conditions that must hold for this stage to be considered complete. Each entry is a single criterion statement.

decision_point.description: Optional decision gate ID that gates entry to or completion of this stage. Resolves in decisions/gates.yaml. Pattern: DG- (gate prefix), variant letters/numbers, hyphen, two-digit number.

owner_agent.description: Kebab-case agent identifier that is accountable for this stage. Must resolve to a real agent file.
